summary: An Internet Architecture Board memo describing the standardization state of Internet protocols at the time. It is historic and was replaced by RFC 2000, one of a regular series of such lists.

eli5.summary: Like a report card for all the network rules, showing which ones were official and which were still being tested. This one is old and was replaced by a newer list.
